thread:
olivia: Proposal: add 'Clip & Snapshot' action on per-route and per-model filter bars — copies all active filters + model pins to clipboard as a JSON snippet + transient telemetry tag. Quick way to share views with teammates and to create a new saved query. Thoughts? :clipboard:

jia: Love the idea. One concern: how do we handle sensitive filters (customer_id, email) — should we scrub by default?

sam: Yes scrub defaults. Maybe add opt-out via user setting. Also we should NOT include tenant-specific ids. Rebinding across orgs would be a privacy hole.

lenore: Agreed. I'd prefer placeholders + a server-side rebind endpoint that only works within the same org. Example contract: POST /api/internal/clip/rebind { clip: <json>, org_id: <id> }

olivia: Nice. Also planning to attach telemetry meta: clip_source=console_filter_bar and clip_saved_attempted=true when user converts clip -> saved query.

mike: UX Q — 1-click icon or small flyout with 'Copy JSON' and 'Create saved query' options?

jia: Flyout. Show scrubbed fields count and let user confirm. Also show model-cost preview when a model filter is included (estimate tokens).

sam: On API side saved queries need name + scope (route/model/org). Rebind flow should accept optional scope_hint: [route:..., model:...] so we can auto-resolve.

olivia: We'll add scope_hint. Also add rate-limit note: creating saved queries should be cheap but protect from spam. @dev-bot can you confirm current defaults?

dev-bot: autosave-quota=100/day per-user; create-saved-view-rate-limit=10/min default (infra)

lenore: Telemetry events to emit: clip_clicked, clip_copied, clip_saved, clip_rebind_success, clip_rebind_fail. Tag with route_id (if not scrubbed), model_version, scrubbed_fields_count.

mike: Edge case — filters that include long prompt templates or embeddings. Don't include full content; include preview (first 100 chars) + indicator truncated=true.

olivia: I'll draft API snippet + a tiny flyout mock and ping security + infra for review. @lenore @sam can you take first pass on the contract?

jia: I'll put a Figma mock by EOD and add a 'share via expiring link' option (tokenized, expire=7d).

sam: SGTM. If infra can hook quota/telemetry we can ship internal prod test next week. :thumbsup:
